prereqs.name: Embedding
prereqs.label: Required
prereqs.evidence: L3 dinh nghia embedding: bien doan text thanh vector so, hai cau gan nghia thi vector gan nhau, do bang cosine similarity. L6 [02:10] dung embedding de giang dense retrieval ma KHONG dinh nghia lai.
prereqs.review: On lai khai niem embedding va cosine similarity truoc khi vao bai RAG.

prereqs.name: Chunking
prereqs.label: Required
prereqs.evidence: L4 slide 14-17: chunk 500 tokens, overlap 50 tokens; L6 [Slide 6] gia dinh chunk 500 tokens, overlap 50 ma khong giang lai chunking.
prereqs.review: Nam rule chunk 500 tokens/overlap 50 va anh huong cua chunking xau den retrieval.

prereqs.name: Retriever
prereqs.label: Required
prereqs.evidence: L6 pipeline: retrieve bang retriever lay top-50; INTENT: retriever loc nhanh top-50, reranker xep lai top-5.
prereqs.review: Hieu vai tro retriever loc nhanh top-50 truoc khi rerank.

prereqs.name: Reranking
prereqs.label: Taught-in-lesson
prereqs.evidence: L6 [09:00] Reranking duoc day ky trong bai (cross-encoder cham tung cap query-document); [14:20] reranker KHONG thay duoc retriever.
prereqs.review: Se hoc ky trong bai: cross-encoder rerank top-5, khong thay the retriever.
